subject: Env certification & network acceptance for Private deployment (VPC)
messages:
From: Carol Li <carol.li@medsys.io>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: Patrick O'Neill <patrick.oneill@medsys.io>
Date: 2028-04-26T15:32:00-07:00
Subject: Request: environment certification & network acceptance criteria

Hi Neha —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our security team is gating the Private deployment and asked for two deliverables before we schedule the provisioning window: a formal environment certification checklist we can sign off on, and the network acceptance criteria (firewall rules, egress allowlist, latency expectations). They also want a short list of vendor evidence we can provide to internal auditors.

Can you share an initial checklist and any diagrams you have? If you prefer, we can set a sync tomorrow with our infra lead (Patrick) to walk through the network diagram.

Goal: close the gating questions this week so we can request the Dedicated capacity quota.

Thanks,
Carol Li
Head of Cloud Ops — Medisys Health
[attachment: initial-questions.txt (txt)]

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Carol Li <carol.li@medsys.io>
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-26T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: environment certification & network acceptance criteria

Hi Carol —

Thanks for outlining the asks. Attaching a draft environment certification checklist and the latest network topology (PDF). High level:

- Env cert checklist covers account setup, IAM/service account scoping, KMS/HSM usage, audit-log retention, and connectivity validation steps.
- Network acceptance includes required ports, IP ranges for Redwood egress, mutual TLS requirements for the private control plane, and a small latency SLA for intra-region control calls.
- Vendor evidence: we propose a short bundle (SOC2 cert pdf pointer, pen-test summary, and an operations runbook excerpt).

Next steps I propose:
1) Review the attached checklist and mark anything you need added.
2) Steph and Marcus will review network specifics and flag any additional evidence items.
3) If OK, we schedule a 30-min call tomorrow with Patrick to walk the topology.

Attachments: env-cert-checklist-2028.xlsx, network-topology-v2.pdf

Neha Kapoor
Manager, Solutions Engineering — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1-415-555-0132
[attachment: env-cert-checklist-2028.xlsx (xlsx); network-topology-v2.pdf (pdf)]

From: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, Carol Li <carol.li@medsys.io>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: environment certification & network acceptance criteria

Carol / Neha —

I reviewed the draft checklist and added inline comments on the shared sheet (link above). A few specific asks from infra/security that typically come up on Private deployments:

- Proof of key handling: we can provide KMS integration notes and a screenshot of key rotation policy in our control plane.
- Network evidence: recommended golden artifacts: (a) a sanitized iptables/ACL snippet, (b) measured p95 latency numbers between control plane and customer VPC for a sustained 60-second window, (c) egress allowlist entries and ASN ranges.
- Pen-test summary: we cannot share full report but can provide an exec summary + remediation attestation.

Vendor evidence list (short):
- SOC2 Type II (redacted cover page + date)
- 3rd-party pen-test summary (exec)
- KMS/HSM attestation + key rotation policy
- Retention & audit log sample (1-week slice)

I'll also attach a one-page acceptance rubric we use internally for network gating. If you want, we can pre-populate the rubric with your values and bring it to the call.

Cheers,
Stephanie Nguyen
Principal Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference
[attachment: vendor-compliance-evidence-list.docx (docx); network-acceptance-rubric.pdf (pdf)]

Team / Carol —

Quick summary after my review and a short sync with Steph:

Action items (owner / ETA):
- Marcus: run a 60s p95 latency probe from control-plane to Medisys test VPC and upload results (2028-04-29 17:00 UTC).
- Neha: share redacted SOC2 cover page + pen-test exec summary (2028-04-28 EOD) — DONE (linked).
- Carol / Patrick: confirm the internal auditor contact and preferred format for evidence (PDF bundle vs secure link) (2028-04-29).
- Stephanie: finalize the network acceptance rubric with values pre-populated for the Medisys environment (2028-04-29 morning).

Accept / Gate criteria (short):
- No open high-severity findings in vendor summary.
- p95 control-plane latency < 120ms on measurement window.
- Required ports allowed and mutual TLS validated.

I'll publish the evidence bundle to the Drive folder and post a signed checklist once Marcus' probe completes and Carol confirms auditor contact.

Marcus Lin
Senior Network Reliability Engineer — Redwood Inference
